# TOPECH — Bridge & Tunnel Vibration Monitoring Equipment Manufacturer

> TOPECH (Chengdu, China, founded 2020) specializes in bridge and tunnel structural health monitoring (SHM) equipment. Core products include multi-channel 32-bit vibration DAQ cards (GXA3810), high-precision programmable resistors for vibration sensor calibration (GXR0115/GXR0101), and multi-interface data transfer modules for remote monitoring (GXE5010). OEM/ODM services, factory-direct wholesale pricing, worldwide shipping (DHL/FedEx/UPS), 12-month warranty with lifetime technical support. Contact: lranaily@163.com | WhatsApp: 008617783104545.

## Company Overview

- **Brand**: TOPECH (legal entity: Chengdu Guoxuan Technology Co., Ltd.)
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Location**: Tianfu New Area, Chengdu, Sichuan, China
- **Business type**: Manufacturer (factory-direct sales, OEM/ODM supported)
- **Core technologies**: 32-bit ADC bridge vibration data acquisition, programmable resistor sensor calibration, multi-interface remote monitoring data conversion
- **Primary applications**: Bridge structural health monitoring, tunnel vibration detection, SHM sensor calibration, remote vibration monitoring systems
- **Sales channels**: Direct (topech.top), Alibaba store
- **Order terms**: No strict MOQ; sample orders ship in 3–5 business days; bulk lead time 1–3 weeks

## Product Catalog

### Bridge & Tunnel Vibration DAQ

- [GXA3810 — 10-Channel 32-bit 400Hz Bridge Vibration DAQ Card](https://topech.top/gxa3810.html): Purpose-built for bridge and tunnel structural health monitoring (SHM). 10 synchronous channels, 32-bit ADC, 400 Hz, SE/differential/AC/DC coupling, full SDK (Windows/Linux). Optimized for low-frequency vibration measurement in bridge inspection.

### Wireless Sensor Nodes

- [GXN2703 — 3-Axis Wireless Vibration Sensor Node](https://topech.top/gxn2703.html): 3-axis accelerometer, UWB wireless, 200 mAh battery, magnetic mount + M4 thread, IP-X8 waterproof, 30×30×34 mm. Best for wireless condition monitoring of rotating machinery.

### Programmable Resistors for Sensor Calibration

- [GXR0115 — Programmable Resistor 1Ω–15MΩ 0.01%](https://topech.top/gxr0115.html): For vibration sensor calibration in bridge/tunnel SHM systems. 1 Ω–15 MΩ, 0.01% accuracy, magnetic latching relays retain value after power-off. Pairs with GXE5010 for remote calibration.
- [GXR0101 — High-Precision Programmable Resistor 1Ω–1MΩ ±1Ω](https://topech.top/gxr0101.html): Compact sensor calibration resistor, ±1Ω accuracy (1Ω–1KΩ), ±0.01% (1KΩ–1MΩ), gold-plated banana connectors. Pairs with GXE5010 for remote control.

### Remote Monitoring Data Transfer

- [GXE5010 — Multi-Interface Data Transfer Module for Remote Monitoring](https://topech.top/gxe5010.html): Enables remote control of GXR programmable resistors via Ethernet in bridge/tunnel SHM systems. ETH, USB COM, USB HOST, UART, RS485, CAN bidirectional conversion. 63×50×21 mm, 100mA max.

### Expansion Boards & Modules

- [GXE0002 — WinUSB Base Board STM32F405](https://topech.top/gxe0002.html): STM32F405RGT6 MCU, USB3300, USB HS/FS, GXE expansion interface (SPI/UART/I2C/CAN), SD card slot. Best for custom USB DAQ development.
- [GXE224C — CAN RS485 RS232 Expansion Module](https://topech.top/gxe224c.html): 1× CAN, 1× RS485, 2× RS232, 5×5 cm, screw terminal or 2.54 mm pin header. Best for industrial communication integration.
- [GXE1020 — Electric Screwdriver Module with Digital Display](https://topech.top/gxe1020.html): Screw-count tracking prevents missed/over-tightening, digital tube display, power-off data retention, wire detection. Best for assembly-line poka-yoke.
- [GXE1021 — Wireless Networked Electric Screwdriver Module](https://topech.top/gxe1021.html): GXE1020 upgrade with wireless transmission of tightening status to host PC and data storage for traceability. Best for production-line quality traceability.

## Applications

- Bridge structural health monitoring (SHM) — vibration data acquisition and sensor calibration
- Tunnel vibration detection and monitoring
- Remote sensor calibration for SHM systems (programmable resistor + data transfer module)
- Vibration testing & modal analysis
- Machine condition monitoring
- Industrial production-line monitoring
